children: Hycroft announced technical progress toward production and unveiled a refreshed brand identity and updated corporate presentation.
Issued press release and furnished an updated corporate presentation and redesigned website on Sept 21, 2026.
Finalizing assessments for underground development at Brimstone and Vortex with RESPEC and conceptual mine planning.
Completed roasting metallurgical tests and conducting a trade-off analysis versus pressure oxidation; roasting could enable sulfuric acid sales.
Continuing engineering, environmental, permitting work and metallurgical testing to evaluate a potential heap leach restart.
Expect two additional core rigs in Q4 2026 to accelerate drilling on Vortex, Brimstone and other targets.
